name: onlycu
description: Cloudflare-native Telegram Mini App for direct creator payments and manual verification.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n worker,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@onlycu/worker" "npm run dev --workspace=@onlycu/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@onlycu/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@onlycu/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@onlycu/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace=@onlycu/web
